mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${table} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, task_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, lock_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, trigger_time DATETIME NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, finished_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, host VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, duration_ms BIGINT DEFAULT NULL, error VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_srl_task_time (task_name, trigger_time), KEY idx_srl_status_started (status, started_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (id, task_name, lock_name, trigger_time, started_at, finished_at, host, status, duration_ms, gmt_create) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.taskName}, #{row.lockName}, #{row.triggerTime}, #{row.startedAt}, #{row.finishedAt}, #{row.host}, #{row.status}, #{row.durationMs}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_name AS taskName, lock_name AS lockName, trigger_time AS triggerTime, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, host, status, duration_ms AS durationMs, error FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT trigger_time FROM ${table} WHERE task_name = #{taskName} AND status = 'DONE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
